baselineInterpretation: All twenty-seven moves and four overall blunders received two complete independent catalog reviews and anonymous adjudication of every serious candidate. Four card tags and one overall link survive the final exact-definition review. The lower count is not leniency by quota: unsupported generalizations are not automatically base-rate neglect, an explicit analogy is not automatically equivocation, and a directly relevant incomplete clarification is not automatically a red herring. Weaknesses remain fully described in the unchanged critiques and numerical scores.
